segments.contextAfter: `completionHandler`: A block with code to execute after the save-and-close operation concludes. The block returns no value and has one parameter: - **`success`**: [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) if any save operation succeeds, otherwise [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false). The block is invoked on the main queue.
